World’s Highest Infinity Pool and Beachfront Luxury at JBR (official resort page): Address Beach Resort is a luxurious 5-star hotel in JBR, Dubai, boasting stunning views of the Bluewaters Island and Ain Dubai. This iconic Dubai beach resort features two 77-story towers with luxurious hotel rooms. Enjoy world-class amenities, including the highest outdoor infinity pool in the world – a Guinness World Record holder – gourmet dining at beachfront restaurants, pampering spa treatments, and direct access to JBR beach. Forbes Travel Guide 5-star rating | One MICHELIN Key Hotel.

Unrivalled Luxury Stays (official): Experience opulent luxury at Address Beach Resort, offering a range of rooms and suites designed for every kind of stay, with breathtaking views of Dubai Marina and the iconic Ain Dubai. Choose from elegant Club Rooms, indulgent Jacuzzi Pool Suites, spacious family Interconnecting Rooms, or step into refined Residences for extended-stay living.

Official FAQ — What makes Address Beach Resort unique? Address Beach Resort is a luxurious beachfront haven in JBR, Dubai, holding two Guinness World Records: the world’s highest infinity pool and the tallest occupiable skyscraper with a continuous facade.

Official FAQ — Does Address Beach Resort have direct beach access? Yes. Perfectly situated along JBR, the resort offers direct beach access to JBR beach, with Dubai Marina, Bluewaters Island, and Ain Dubai just moments away.

Official FAQ — What dining options are available at Address Beach Resort? The resort offers world-class dining in JBR for every taste, from ZETA Seventy Seven and Pepe Cucina to The Restaurant, The Beach Grill, and The Lounge. Guests can also enjoy outsourced venues including Mott 32, OSH DEL MAR, DREAMS, Dreams of Garden, and Via Toledo.

Official dining page venues: ZETA Seventy Seven (Asian Fusion); The Beach Grill (International); The Restaurant at Address Beach Resort (Global Bistronomy); The Lounge at Address Beach Resort (Light Bites); DREAM (Mediterranean Fusion); Garden of Dreams (Mediterranean Fusion); Pepe Cucina (Italian); Osh Del Mar (Seafood & Light Bites); Mott 32 (Chinese). Official dining FAQ: dining experiences across 8 exceptional venues; restaurants open to non-hotel guests; smart-casual dress code; valet parking for restaurant guests.

Official FAQ — What wellness facilities does Address Beach Resort offer? The resort features four stunning swimming pools, including three at the ground level (a dedicated family pool & adult-only pools). Guests can enjoy the iconic infinity pool on Level 77, recognized as the world’s highest outdoor infinity pool. Additionally, the resort boasts a state-of-the-art fitness center and an award-winning spa.

Official FAQ — What makes The Spa at Address Beach Resort special? The Spa at Address Beach Resort is a serene sanctuary located on the 75th floor, making it the highest spa in Dubai. All nine luxurious treatment rooms offer breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf. Premium facilities include relaxation lounges and steam rooms.

Official FAQ — Is Address Beach Resort family-friendly? Absolutely. We welcome families with spacious family rooms, child-friendly amenities, The Qix Kids Club with an outdoor splash pad, and dedicated family pool areas. Guests can also take advantage of kids eat and stay free options.

Official FAQ — How close is Address Beach Resort to Dubai’s major attractions? Conveniently located in Jumeirah Beach Residences, within minutes of Ain Dubai, Dubai Marina Mall, and Bluewaters Island. Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Expo City Dubai are a short drive away. Dubai Tram and Metro are within walking distance.

Official FAQ — Does the resort host events or meetings? Events spaces include The Academy, a sophisticated space featuring a state-of-the-art show kitchen, a welcoming Majlis, an elegant library, and versatile meeting rooms.

Calm in the city (official Jumeirah story, full copy used): Cities often pulse with a frenetic energy, and Dubai is no exception. Here, towering skyscrapers dominate the skyline, and the daily hustle creates a dynamic rhythm. While many seek an escape for relaxation, why not enjoy both? Jumeirah Living World Trade Centre Residences offers a serene space amidst Dubai’s vibrant atmosphere. Enjoy the city’s finest restaurants, shops, and theatres from a place that fosters a harmonious balance of well-being and social experiences. Drawing inspiration from the city's skyline, desert sands, and mangroves, our residences create a soothing synergy between urban and natural worlds. Here, everyone who enters feels not just calm, but truly at home.

Designed to evoke a sense of belonging, the expansive living spaces at Jumeirah Living World Trade Centre Residences flow seamlessly into master suites and fully equipped kitchens, all set against floor-to-ceiling windows that frame the city’s glittering lights. More than just a place to rest, this complex includes an advanced gym, yoga studio, co-working office spaces, an outdoor pool, and Olivine, the rooftop restaurant. Perched above the city, Olivine offers a tranquil setting with its neutral tones and natural light. Whether dining indoors in a relaxed ambiance, or outside in the balmy breeze, the menu's fusion of Arabic, British, and international flavours cater to every palate. On the rooftop, an elegantly understated pergola invites you to linger over your meal against the cityscape’s inspiring backdrop.

Our secluded co-working spaces are perfectly suited for remote workdays. Here, office pods feature an open office space and lounge seating design. For complete privacy, our single and double glass office pods provide an undisturbed environment for focused work or confidential meetings.

Our residences feature a bespoke gym located on the 29th floor, equipped with the latest in fitness technology by Matrix, and staffed by expert personal trainers, ready to design a tailored workout programme for you, from intensive HIIT training to a rhythmic Zumba class. Our yoga studio is a sanctuary with a soothing earthy palette and soft, filtered light. Alternatively, venture to the rooftop, where the pristine waters of our laned pool invite you for a refreshing dip.

Olivine (official dining page, full copy): A rooftop terrace showcases a global culinary journey, where sweeping panoramic views, refined presentation, and elegant surroundings transform every meal into a memorable and immersive occasion. Serviced Apartments Dubai
Citadines Metro Central Dubai offers a welcoming home for travellers seeking comfort and strategic convenience in the heart of this dynamic city. Located in Barsha Heights, a bustling business and residential district, our serviced apartments provide an ideal base for business commitments and city exploration. The property is located directly opposite the Dubai Internet City Metro Station, providing effortless, swift access to key destinations across the city. From this central hub, guests can easily reach popular areas such as Dubai Marina, Jumeirah Beach, and Palm Jumeirah, as well as the extensive shopping at Mall of the Emirates and Dubai Mall, making it a highly practical choice for corporate and leisure guests alike.

Our 208 spacious apartments in Dubai, ranging from modern studios to expansive one-bedroom layouts, are meticulously designed to offer a true sense of home. Each serviced apartment features a fully equipped kitchen, allowing guests to prepare their own meals with ease, along with separate living, dining, and bedroom areas. This thoughtful design provides ample space for relaxation and productivity, creating a calm, home-style environment that offers a comfortable retreat from the vibrant energy of Dubai. Comprehensive in-room amenities include a flat-screen television with digital channels, an in-unit safe, central air-conditioning, and complimentary Wi-Fi. For added convenience, many apartments also feature a washing machine and dryer, making them ideal for long and extended-stay accommodation in the heart of the city.

Guests staying at our serviced apartments in Dubai benefit from a comprehensive array of premium facilities. Maintain an active lifestyle at our on-site gym within the Pure White Health Club and Fitness Centre, or enjoy the rooftop swimming pool featuring spectacular city views. For ultimate relaxation, we offer a steam room and the Elite Casa Spa and Wellness Centre. Professional needs are met with dedicated business facilities, including the Nexus Meeting Room and Business Centre, all supported by 24-hour front desk and concierge services and complimentary secure parking.

Dining and guest well-being are central to our experience. We offer convenient on-site dining at Brambles Cafe, renowned for its healthy breakfast and light meal options. To ensure your peace of mind, we have implemented enhanced hygiene standards supporting guest well-being in Dubai, creating a safe and healthy environment for both short and extended stays.

Ascott Cares — Citadines Metro Central Dubai has implemented the Ascott Cares 9 commitments to hygiene, cleanliness and safe distancing.
Dubai Assured — Citadines Metro Central Dubai has been awarded with the Dubai Assured quality mark for our commitment in upholding good sanitation and hygiene practices.

description:
Premium Rooms and Residences in Dubai Marina

Residences
Discover the unparalleled luxury of Grosvenor House Residences, Dubai. Our exquisite rooms, suites or 1, 2, and 3-bedroom residences offer stunning Dubai Marina and Arabian Gulf views. Enjoy spacious living areas, and opulent bathrooms featuring premium amenities. Benefit from complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, 42-inch flat-screen TVs, and dedicated butler service. Experience sophisticated design and impeccable five-star service, blending hotel luxury with the comforts of home for an unforgettable stay.

Temporary Renovation
Please note that certain public areas in the hotel are undergoing renovation until further notice.

The Residence
The Residence includes Premier Rooms and Suites, alongside the 216 Residences available for long-term and short-term residence. Each guest room, suite and residences many with private balconies, enjoys breathtaking panoramic views over The Arabian Gulf, Palm Jumeirah and Dubai Marina, adding yet another dimension to the Grosvenor House Dubai experience. Simply put, the rooms inspire the tone of the hotel, offering the highest levels of restrained luxury that appeal to business travelers and pleasure seekers alike.

Premier Suites
A discerning choice for professional or private guests, Premier Suites and Executive Premier Suites promise an elegant and effortless stay. Nestled between the fifth and tenth floors of The Residences, they overlook the sparkling Arabian Sea, Palm Jumeirah, or Dubai Marina through floor-to-ceiling windows. Select suites also offer a private balcony furnished with a table and chairs.

Premier Rooms
Experience elevated comfort in our Premier Rooms, located on floors five through ten of The Residence. These rooms offer stunning views of the Arabian Sea, Palm Jumeirah, or Dubai Marina, with select rooms featuring a private balcony.
Inside, enjoy complimentary high-speed internet, a 47-inch flat screen while you control your environment with a touchscreen panel for lighting and air conditioning. Rest on our signature Luxury Collection beds with premium linens.
The elegant bathroom features a deep bathtub, standalone shower, and premium bath amenities. Indulge in plush bathrobes and slippers, with a personal butler at your service.
Guests booking directly with the hotel also receive complimentary Dubai International Airport transfers and exclusive access to our Executive Business Lounge, which includes breakfast, afternoon tea, and pre-dinner drinks.

Premier Suites (elevated copy)
Indulge in an elegant and effortless stay in our Premier and Executive Premier Suites, located on floors five to ten of The Residence. Enjoy stunning views of the Arabian Sea, Palm Jumeirah, or Dubai Marina through floor-to-ceiling windows, with select suites offering a private balcony.
Relax in the spacious lounge area featuring a 47-inch interactive TV with complimentary high-speed internet access. Executive Premier Suites also include a pantry with a refrigerator and a six-guest dining table.
The large bedroom boasts a plush king-size signature Luxury Collection bed with 400-thread-count sheets and a second television. The elegantly appointed bathroom features, deep bathtub, standalone shower, and premium bath amenities.
Guests also receive transfers to and from Dubai International Airport and exclusive access to our Executive Business Lounge, offering complimentary breakfast, pre-dinner drinks, and more.

Grosvenor and Royal Suites
Experience unparalleled luxury in our Grosvenor or Royal Suites, located on the ninth and tenth floors of The Residence. These expansive suites offer panoramic views of the Dubai Marina or Palm Jumeirah through floor-to-ceiling windows.
Each Suite features a spacious lounge area, a fully equipped kitchenette, and a dining area, perfect for entertaining.
Enjoy state-of-the-art amenities, including complimentary high-speed internet, a convenient touchscreen control panel for an effortless stay.
The master bedroom offers a plush king-size Luxury Collection bed and a private sitting area for ultimate relaxation. The en-suite master bathroom is a sanctuary with a Jacuzzi, rainforest shower, dry sauna, and premium bath amenities.
Furthermore, a 24-hour personal butler is dedicated to fulfilling your every request.
The 200-square-meter Majlis-style Chamber can be connected to the Grosvenor Suite, creating a larger three-bedroom apartment, or utilized as a spacious one-bedroom suite.

Unparalleled Luxury of Grosvenor House Residences
Residences for Long Stays — Elevated Living, Unforgettable Views
Perched on the eleventh floor and above, The Residences offer a new standard of upscale living with one, two, and three-bedroom residences. Each home features expansive windows that frame breathtaking views of the Dubai Marina, Arabian Sea, or Palm Jumeirah.

Redefine Daily Living: Premium Long-Stay Apartments in Dubai Marina
Our Residences, featuring high ceilings and spacious living areas, are exquisitely designed in elegant neutral hues. The fully equipped kitchen, with black marble countertops, includes a refrigerator, dishwasher, crockery, and cutlery. Choose between a closed kitchen with extra cabinets or an open one with a breakfast bar. A six-guest dining table provides an intimate space for meals. The master bedroom boasts a king-size Luxury Collection bed with 400-thread-count sheets, a down comforter, and plump pillows, framed by an upholstered headboard and bedside tables. A chaise lounge, armchair, interactive flat-screen TV, and modern work desk complete the room. Additional bedrooms offer king-size or twin beds. Each bedroom features a walk-in wardrobe leading to a spacious en-suite bathroom with a brown marble vanity, deep bathtub, separate shower, exclusive amenities, plush bathrobes, and slippers. Some residences include a guest washroom and laundry/storage room.

At the core of Flying Elephant is its signature concept—Mystical Mixology. This innovative approach to cocktail creation takes classic recipes and transforms them with Indian ingredients, flavours, and stories. From tamarind and jaggery to kokum and aromatic spices, each element is carefully chosen to evoke a sense of nostalgia while offering a fresh twist. Whether you’re indulging in a bold Old-Fashioned Delhi, a tangy Margarita with a kick, or a smoky Spiced Paloma, each drink offers a journey through taste, culture, and creativity. The ambiance is as carefully curated as the cocktails. Flying Elephant is both intimate and electric, with vintage décor, low lighting, and handpicked sounds that evolve from chilled lounge beats to upbeat live music performances. Conveniently located just minutes from Mall of the Emirates. Guests can pair their handcrafted drinks with flavour-forward small plates, and explore a weekly calendar of immersive events—from Bollywood Lounge Nights every Monday to the high-energy Elephant in the Room Mystical Brunch every Saturday afternoon. InterContinental Residences Dubai Business Bay Destination — Dubai Business Bay is a vibrant urban district located in the heart of Dubai, known for its impressive skyscrapers, upscale residences, and bustling business activity.
Explore the Iconic Burj Khalifa — Welcome to the heart of Dubai, where architectural marvel meets modern luxury! Just a stone's throw away from our location, the Burj Khalifa stands tall as a testament to human ingenuity and design. As the world’s tallest building, this iconic skyscraper offers an unparalleled experience for visitors and is a must-see attraction on your itinerary.
Things to do: Burj Khalifa — The tallest building in the world, Burj Khalifa, is a must visit to witness breathtaking views of the city from the observation decks on the 124th and 148th floors. Don't forget to capture memorable photos of the skyline and surrounding landmarks.
The Dubai Mall — Dubai Mall is the largest shopping mall in Dubai. It is the second largest mall in the world by total land area after the Iran Mall, and the 26th-largest shopping mall in the world by gross leasable area, with a total retail floor area of 350,000 sq.m. It also has 22 cinema screens plus 120 restaurants and cafes. The mall has over 14,000 parking spaces across 3 car parks, with valet services and a car locator ticketing system. The 350,000 sq.m figure is official Dubai Mall floor area, not a guest-suite size, and is not written onto suite unitTypes.
Dubai Opera — Dubai Opera is a world-class performing arts center located in Downtown Dubai. It's a versatile venue that can host a variety of performances. The building is designed to resemble a traditional dhow boat, a type of sailing vessel used in the region for centuries. It has a seating capacity of 2,000 and features state-of-the-art acoustics and lighting. The 2,000 figure is official Dubai Opera seating, not a guest-suite size.
Museum of the Future — It is a landmark devoted to innovative and futuristic ideologies. Located in the Financial District of Dubai, UAE . The museum is dedicated to exploring the future of science, technology, and innovation. The Museum of the Future is a torus-shaped building with windows in the form of a poem about the future, written by His Highness Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum, Vice President and Prime Minister of the United Arab Emirates and Ruler of Dubai. It was founded by the Dubai Future Foundation.

Official address: Sheikh Mohammed Bin Rashed Boulevard, Downtown Dubai, PO Box 111969, Dubai, UAE. Official telephone +971 4 873 8888 (header) / +971 42 458 888 (FAQ reservations line).

Official residences introduction: We believe in providing peerless service based on the philosophy that our residents deserve only the finest, and should want for nothing. Welcome to Address Residences Sky View.

Iconic Luxury in a Prime Location and Unparalleled Views (official hotel page): Discover luxury with an unparalleled view at Address Sky View. This hotel in Downtown offers breathtaking panoramas, iconic infinity pool overlooking Burj Khalifa. Renowned for its prime location with direct access to Dubai Mall and metro station, Address Sky View is a haven for both leisure and business travellers.

Iconic Stays (official): In this skyline-defining duo of towers joined by an architecturally marvellous Sky Bridge, embrace the unique privilege of staying ‘Where Life Happens’. Official stay products: Rooms and Residences.

1-Bedroom Residences (official residences page, full copy): Warmth and class combine with exemplary flair across a broad range of unique layouts in our one-bedroom residences. In addition to plush furnishings and spacious environs, you can choose from a palette of features, including a study, balcony, and much more. Official bullets: Luxurious one-bedroom residences; Size: 97.5 sqm; Up to 2 guests; City views; King-size bed & built-in closets; Modern kitchen & dining room; Two bathrooms; Separate bathtub, rain shower & vanity area.

2-Bedroom Residences (official, full copy): Stunning views of the city and Burj Khalifa combine with modern expressions of luxury living in the two-bedroom residences. Come home to a suave, ingeniously laid-out abode with exquisite furnishings and superior comforts you and your family deserve. Official bullets: Stunning two-bedroom residences; Size: 184.7sqm; Up to 4 guests; Views of the Burj Khalifa or the City; King-size bed & built-in closets; Modern kitchen; Three bathrooms; Separate bathtub, rain shower & vanity area; Balcony.

3-Bedroom Residences (official, full copy): Superbly styled to align with the elegance of Downtown Dubai, our three-bedroom residences are endowed with an opulent living room, dining area, and large bedrooms. Not impressed? Draw the curtain and unveil striking views of Dubai’s marvellous skyline. Official bullets: Exquisite 3-bedroom residences; Size: 614.7 sqm; Up to 6 guests; Views of the Burj Khalifa or the City; King- or twin-size beds and built-in closets; Modern kitchen & dining area; Five bathrooms; Maid’s room.

4-Bedroom Residences (official, full copy): You are sure to love our generous, four-bedroom residences. In addition to wide, welcoming expanses, they offer scintillating perspectives on refined living and Dubai’s dazzling cityscape. The perfect base for your journey of discoveries. Official bullets: Superior 4-bedroom duplex; Size: 201.7 sqm; Up to 8 guests; Views of the Burj Khalifa or the City; King- or twin-size beds and built-in closets; Modern kitchen & dining area; Five bathrooms; Maid’s room.

5-Bedroom Residences (official, full copy): Situated on the highest levels of the taller skyscraper, there’s only ONE five-bedroom residence. A dedicated family area complements the four bedrooms on the lower level, while the lavish living and dining areas offer spectacular perspectives of the city. Official bullets: One-of-a-kind 5-bedroom duplex; Size: 285.9 sqm; Up to 10 guests; Views of the Burj Khalifa or the City; King- or twin-size beds and built-in closets; Two balconies; Six bathrooms; Maid’s room.

6-Bedroom Residences / Sky Collection (official, full copy): The only abode of its kind at Address Sky View, the six-bedroom residence is the crowning glory of our Sky Collection. Come home to the distinctive aesthetics and captivating views of the city and the world’s tallest tower. It’s simply the ultimate Address. Official bullets: Immaculate 6-bedroom duplex; Size: 643.9sqm; Up to 12 guests; Views of the Burj Khalifa or the City; Comfortable family area on the lower level; Two vast balconies with lounge and dining areas; Seven bathrooms; Maid’s room & more.

Official FAQ — What is the standard check-in time and check-out time at Address Sky View? The designated time for standard check-in is 3:00 PM, and for check-out, it is scheduled for 12:00 PM.

Official FAQ — What accommodation options are available at Address Sky View? Discover an array of picturesque accommodations at Address Sky View, featuring an exquisite selection of rooms and suites that cater to diverse preferences. Among the enticing choices are the Premier Room King, Premier Room Twin, Premier Burj View Room King, Premier Burj View Room Twin, Club Room King, Club Room Twin, Junior Suite, Executive Suite, and the opulent Presidential Suite. Residences are listed separately on the official Residences page (1–6 bedroom).

Official FAQ — What room amenities are available at Address Sky View? Step into an elevated realm of comfort and convenience with our thoughtfully furnished rooms and suites, each equipped with modern amenities for an enhanced stay. Explore the seamless accessibility of our automated in-room iPad service, granting you easy control over various services. Stay connected with complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, and unwind with the added convenience of a coffee machine and tea-making facilities within your space. Your safety is paramount with an in-room security safe. Enjoy entertainment at its finest with an interactive flat-screen TV. Additionally, treat yourself to a private minibar (surcharge applies).

Official FAQ — Does Address Sky View have a spa? Situated on Level 54, The Spa at Address Sky View stands out for its world-class facilities, featuring dedicated spaces for beauty treatments, massage therapies, and a diverse range of wellness experiences, all administered by highly skilled professionals.

Official FAQ — How many restaurants are in Address Sky View? Address Sky View boasts six distinct dining destinations within the hotel: The Restaurant, an all-day dining venue; Deck Too, a poolside lounge; Patisserie, located in the lobby; Alto 54, infinity poolside restaurant; CÉ LA VI, offering contemporary Asian cuisine; Felicità, specialising in Italian fare; Amelia Restaurant and Lounge, presenting a fusion of Peruvian and Japanese flavours.

Official dining page venues: The Restaurant at Address Sky View (Mediterranean); Patisserie (Pastries and Cakes); Deck Too (Pool Lounge); CÉ LA VI (Contemporary Asian); Amelia Restaurant and Lounge (Peruvian Japanese); Alto 54 (Rooftop Pool Lounge); Felicità (Modern Italian).

Official FAQ — What facilities and activities are available at the hotel? From the captivating “Sky View Observatory” to the engaging Qix Kids Club, the multiple swimming pools situated on the ground level, and the mesmerizing infinity pool on Level 54, we provide diverse options for relaxation and recreation. Our spa, fitness centre, and beauty salon cater to wellness and grooming needs, while the six distinctive dining venues present a culinary journey. Additionally, we offer versatile event spaces.

Official FAQ — How far is Address Sky View from Dubai Mall? Dubai Mall is conveniently located just a short stroll away from Address Sky View, with an approximate walking distance of about 10 minutes via the air-conditioned walkway.

Official FAQ — What is Sky Views Observatory? The Sky Views Observatory introduces a groundbreaking outdoor glass slide that propels visitors from level 53 at 219.5 meters to level 52 at 215.5 meters, all within an enclosed and transparent glass tube.

Official FAQ — How do I access the infinity pool as a non-hotel guest? Non-hotel guests are also welcome to enjoy our infinity pool with an Infinity Pool Day Pass.

Jannah Place Dubai Marina - Luxury Fully-Serviced Hotel Apartment

Created for guests seeking a convenient fully-serviced hotel apartment, Jannah Place Dubai Marina provides all the comforts of home with full amenities in one the best locations in Dubai. With a range of leisure and business destinations only minutes away, our long-term guests will always find something interesting to see or do nearby. Can I request for a late check-out? Late check-out is subject to availability. 2 PM onwards is chargeable as half day, after 6 PM onwards chargeable as full night.

Destinations – Discover Dubai (official https://www.jannah-hotels.com/jannah_place/destinations/ ; first printed body of each card)

Al Maktoum International Airport
Al Maktoum International Airport, also known as Dubai World Central, is an international airport in Jebel Ali, 37 kilometres southwest of Dubai, United Arab Emirates that opened on 27 June 2010. It is the main part of Dubai South, a planned residential, commercial and logistics complex.

Blue Water JBR
Blue Water Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) is a sprawling island development just a stone's throw away from the Dubai Marina.
Just a short walk from the Dubai Marina and right at the foot of Ain Dubai, Blue Water Jumeirah Beach Residence (JBR) provides unparalleled views of Dubai’s skyline and oceanscapes. The island development plays host to dozens of critically acclaimed restaurants and attractions.
Blue Water JBR is the perfect place to lounge, dine, and witness Dubai’s stunning architecture.

Burj Khalifa
The world's tallest building is a recent historical landmark, with travellers around the world visiting to ascend to its fabled 124th floor.
There’s little to be said about the Burj Khalifa that hasn’t already been covered by journalists, travel magazines, documentaries, and history books.
The world’s tallest building is a recent historical landmark, with travellers around the world visiting to ascend to its fabled 124th floor. The journey to the top is a dive into Arabian heritage, as the building captures the fantastic story of the Middle East’s climb into prominence.
For information on car rentals or taxi bookings, simply approach our Karim team.

Creekside Park
The historic district of Bur Dubai is home to Creekside Park, a gorgeous destination for residents and travellers looking to enjoy nature at its most scenic.
The historic district of Bur Dubai is home to Creekside Park, a gorgeous destination for residents and travellers looking to enjoy nature at its most scenic. Dhow boats nestle along the river, waiting to take passengers for a ride laden with spectacular views of Dubai.
Visitors can enjoy designated spots for barbecues, picnics, restaurants, bike rentals, mini-golf, and even cable cars. It’s an especially exciting destination for children, who are sure to love Children’s City, an educational adventure park.
Creekside Park is just 30 minutes away from Jannah Place Dubai Marina. For information on car rentals or taxi bookings, simply approach our Karim team.

Dubai International Airport
Dubai International Airport is the primary airport serving the UAE and is the fifth busiest airport by passenger traffic. It is located in the Al Garhoud district and occupies a land area of 125,000 sq km.
Serving over 80 million customers annually and servicing more than 240 destinations over 6 continents, Dubai Airport is arguably one of the most connected terminals in the world. It has also been listed consistently as a top airport in the world, which speaks to its status and reputation as a world-class facility.

Dubai Mall
The Dubai Mall is the world's largest shopping and entertainment destination, receiving 100 million visitors annually. It's a sight to behold, and a haven for the world's most dedicated shoppers.
The Dubai Mall is the world’s largest shopping and entertainment destination, receiving 100 million visitors annually. It’s a sight to behold, and a haven for the world’s most dedicated shoppers.
A near-endless array of stores can be found within, and you’re guaranteed to find more than a handful of shops and attractions to pique your interest. Families are also sure to enjoy the mall’s many restaurants, entertainment centers, and cinemas.

Dubai Marina Mall
The Dubai Marina Mall is a premier destination for shopping and entertainment, located right in the heart of the scenic Marina, just a few minutes away from Jannah Place Dubai Marina.
The Dubai Marina Mall is a premier destination for shopping and entertainment, located right in the heart of the scenic Marina, just a few minutes away from Jannah Place Dubai Marina. Shoppers can choose from a staggering array of brands—from high-street couture to aspirational boutique fashion.
Dine al fresco by the waterside, catch a show at the mall’s cinema, or find the precise items you’ve been looking for in the mall’s 390,000 square feet of retail space.

EXPO
The Dubai EXPO is a massive six-month undertaking to showcase the latest in technology and innovation. It will be held in a 4.38 sq km area in South Dubai, near Al Maktoum International Airport.
The Dubai EXPO is set to run from October 20, 2020 and April 10, 2021. Centered on the theme “Connecting Minds, Creating The Future”, the expo will focus on three main initiatives: sustainability, mobility, and opportunity.
Drawing inspiration from past world expos, visitors should expect to get up and close with the latest and greatest in tech, and get a firsthand peek at some of the most stunning and innovative exhibits in the world.

Global Village
Global Village is a bustling hub of multicultural activity and trade. Over 75 countries are represented among its 32 pavilions, each offering their own traditional products and souvenirs.
Global Village, as its name implies, is a bustling hub of multicultural activity and trade. Over 75 countries are represented among its 32 pavilions, each offering their own traditional products and souvenirs.
Visitors can look forward to cultural shows, stunt acts, spectacles, street performances, and other performances drawn from around the world—as well as exhilarating rides at Fantasy Island. The venue guarantees no end of family-friendly fun, and exposure to the best that the world to offer.
A trip to Global Village wouldn’t be complete without sampling a piece of exotic cuisine (or two, or three), and guests will find plenty of options to choose from.
The Global Village typically opens during the Winter season.

Gold Souk
A trip to the City of Gold is only complete with a visit to Dubai's Gold Souk, a shopping experience marked by the glint of 18, 21, 22, and 24-carat gold at every turn.
A trip to the City of Gold is only complete with a visit to Dubai’s Gold Souk, a shopping experience marked by the glint of 18, 21, 22, and 24-carat gold at every turn. Whether you’re there to shop or simply observe one of the finest assemblages of gold under the sun, a visit to the Gold Souk is guaranteed to leave you with lasting memories.
The scale and variety of gold available for purchase at the souk render many visitors speechless: Marvel at the gold earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, and pendants on display behind the shop windows—or make a purchase and bring the some of the luxury home with you.

Jumeirah Beach Park
This unique 12-hectare beach-park hybrid in the coastal area of Jumeirah, Dubai is an ideal place to spend a relaxing weekend. The opportunities for fun and relaxation are as endless as the area's facilities.
This unique 12-hectare beach-park hybrid in the coastal area of Jumeirah, Dubai is an ideal place to spend a relaxing weekend. Relax on a sun lounger, take a dip in a pool or the ocean, enjoy a round of volleyball, or simply have a picnic on the sand—the opportunities are as endless as the facilities you can find there.
On Wednesdays, Jumeirah Beach Park is reserved for women and children.
Jumeirah Beach Park is just 30 minutes away from Jannah Place Dubai Marina Hotel. For information on car rentals or taxi bookings, simply approach our Karim team

Miracle Garden
Dubai's Miracle Garden is simply that: a miraculous work of horticulture and landscaping. Flowers adorn the pathways, buildings, and greenery at the Miracle Garden.
Dubai’s Miracle Garden is simply that: a miraculous work of horticulture and landscaping, sure to delight visitors of all ages. Flowers adorn the pathways, buildings, and greenery at the Miracle Garden, which itself has earned three distinct Guinness World Records.
Check out their one-of-a-kind, 15-metre floral clock is a massive timepiece that’s built into the grounds, a floral castle surrounded by millions of blossoming flowers, and stunning designs and arrangement that vary as the seasons change.
The Miracle Garden opens its doors yearly, from mid-November to mid-May.

Ski Dubai
Unlikely as it may seem, you can find a winter wonderland right in the heart of Dubai! The Mall of Emirates houses Ski Dubai, a winter-themed attraction complete with penguins and ice sculptures.
Unlikely as it may seem, you can find a winter wonderland right in the heart of Dubai! The Mall of Emirates houses Ski Dubai, a winter-themed attraction complete with penguins and ice sculptures.
Visitors can enjoy an afternoon of skating at the Dubai Ice Rink. Its Olympic size makes it a perfect fit for skaters of any skill level, and on-site trainers are ready to assist newcomers to the activity.
Ski Dubai and the Mall of the Emirates is an easy 15 minutes away from Jannah Place Dubai Marina. For information on car rentals or taxi bookings, simply approach our Karim team.

Spice Souk
You'd be hard pressed to find a more colorful and aromatic market than the Spice Souk in Dubai. There, you can find spices, fragrances, and herbs coveted in places around the world.
You’d be hard pressed to find a more colorful and aromatic market than the Spice Souk in Dubai. There, you can find spices, fragrances, and herbs coveted in places around the world. A variety of household goods, rugs, textiles, and artifacts are also available for sale at the Spice Souk, ready to be purchased by shoppers with the savvy to haggle down to the best price.
We highly recommend a visit to the souk. The volume of trade at the marketplace has declined over the years, thanks to the proliferation of large stores and supermarkets—your visit could help preserve a piece of Arab heritage.

The Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo
The wonders of the underwater world are on display at the Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo. This 10-million litre aquarium found on the ground floor of the Dubai Mall is one of the largest in the world.
The Dubai Aquarium & Underwater Zoo recreates the world’s most mysterious environment in stunning detail, and gives visitors the chance to take a seafloor stroll past ocean creatures and the divers who tend to them. The aquarium showcases live feedings, and educational tours fit for all ages.

The Dubai Fountain
While you're exploring downtown Dubai, take a ride on the Burj Lake, and witness the world's largest performing fountain in action: the Dubai Fountain.
While you’re exploring downtown Dubai, take a ride on the Burj Lake, and witness the world's largest performing fountain in action: the Dubai Fountain.
The Dubai Fountain Lake Ride puts you at the forefront of a spectacular display involving 6,600 lights, 25 colored projectors, 22,000 gallons of airborne water, and world-class choreography set to the best of Arab, classical, and world music. For the icing on the cake, the ride takes you up close to the world-famous Burj Khalifa—how’s that for an unforgettable view?
For information on car rentals or taxi bookings, simply approach our Karim team.

Wadi Shawka
Wadi Shawka is a mountainous area situated 143-km from Dubai. For several years, it has been a popular destination for hikers, off-road enthusiasts, and outdoor lovers.
Known for its hills, valleys (wadis), and rock formations, Wadi Shawka is home to some of the most scenic landscapes in all of Dubai. Whether you’re an adrenaline junkie looking to hop on board a 4×4 or a wandering traveler looking to immerse in nature, Wadi Shawka provides endless activities for outdoor enthusiasts of all kinds.
The area features winding paths and serene campsites with breathtaking views and vibrant wildlife, including tens of kilometers of hiking and driving trails.

Wild Wadi
Wild Wadi is a waterpark built around the richness of Arabian folklore. Visitors can experience the thrilling adventures of Sinbad, soar with the Flood River Flyer, and cool down along the Lazy River.
20 minutes away from the Jannah Place Dubai Marina, Wild Wadi is a waterpark built around the richness of Arabian folklore. The park has countless features and attractions that make a tirp worthwhile: visitors can experience the thrilling adventures of Sinbad, soar with the Flood River Flyer, and cool down along the Lazy River.
Every so often, the park goes as far as to unleash a thundering, choreographed flash flood!
For information on car rentals or taxi bookings, simply approach our Karim team.

Why should I stay at Golden Sands Hotel Apartments instead of a traditional Dubai hotel?
Golden Sands Hotel Apartments is the pioneering hotel apartment brand in Dubai, having literally introduced and started the entire concept of serviced hotel apartment living in the United Arab Emirates.
Golden Sands Hotel Apartments bridges the gap between home comfort and premium hospitality. Unlike traditional hotels, our serviced apartments offer spacious layouts featuring fully equipped kitchens or kitchenettes (including microwaves, refrigerators, and washing machines), coupled with 4-star guest amenities such as scheduled housekeeping, 24-hour reception, and room service. It is highly cost-effective for families, extended stays, and business travelers looking for flexible accommodation in Dubai.
Golden Sands is widely recognized as an award-winning hotel apartment brand in Dubai. Over the last 15 years consistently secured top industry honors, including the prestigious Arabian Travel Awards for Best Family Hotel Apartments for multiple consecutive years. Additionally, our commitment to guest satisfaction is backed by annual TripAdvisor Travellers' Choice Awards, Booking.com Traveller Review Awards, Expedia Guest Review Awards, and MakeMyTrip (MMT) Excellence Awards.
What is the difference between Golden Sands 3, Golden Sands 5, and Golden Sands 10?
All our properties are centrally managed, located in Al Mankhool, Bur Dubai, and provide shared access to key amenities like fitness centers and swimming pools. However, room configurations differ to meet specific travel sizes:
Golden Sands 3: Features 268 units composed of spacious Studios and 1-Bedroom configurations, ideal for small families and corporate travelers.
Golden Sands 5: Features 193 fully furnished Studio apartments, tailored carefully for the independent business traveler.
Golden Sands 10: Features 154 larger 2-Bedroom and 3-Bedroom options, purposefully configured for large families and travel groups.
Which Golden Sands building is best for families with kids?
For families deciding between our three buildings, here's a quick way to choose:
Golden Sands 10: 2- and 3-bedroom Premier apartments, best for larger families of four or more or multi-generational trips.
Golden Sands 3: Studio and 1-bedroom apartments, ideal for smaller families with one or two children.
Golden Sands 5: Studio apartments only, better suited to couples or business travelers rather than families needing separate bedrooms.
All three buildings share access to the kids' club, three swimming pools, and Elysian restaurant.
Is Golden Sands Hotel Apartments an alcohol-free property?
Yes, Golden Sands Hotel Apartments is a dry, alcohol-free property. We pride ourselves on cultivating a safe, wholesome, and welcoming family-centric atmosphere for all international and regional guests.
Where can I book a serviced hotel apartment in Dubai?
You can book a fully serviced hotel apartment directly through the official website of Golden Sands Hotel Apartments in Bur Dubai. Offering a direct-booking best rate guarantee, the property features 616 fully managed serviced units ranging from executive studios to multi-bedroom family suites. Every apartment includes a fully equipped kitchen, an in-unit washing machine, daily housekeeping, and 24/7 reception support. Bookings can be secured instantly via our online reservation system on our Stay page.
What are the best hotel apartments for long stays in Dubai?
Golden Sands Hotel Apartments is widely regarded as one of the best choices for extended and long-term stays in Dubai due to its residential-style configurations and central location in Al Mankhool, Bur Dubai. Perfect for remote professionals, corporate travelers, and families, our long-stay apartments provide the comforts of home—such as full culinary kitchens, private laundry facilities, and spacious living areas—combined with hotel amenities including three outdoor pools, a modern health club, and 24-hour security. Special monthly and seasonal extended-stay rates are accessible directly through our Offers page.
How to find furnished apartments with hotel amenities in Dubai?
To find premium furnished apartments paired with full hotel amenities in Dubai, travelers look to established properties like Golden Sands Hotel Apartments in the historic commercial hub of Bur Dubai. Our apartments come completely furnished with comprehensive kitchen appliances, premium bedding, and dedicated workspace areas. Guests simultaneously enjoy unrestricted access to resort-style hotel facilities, including a 24-hour family restaurant, room service, comprehensive fitness centers, sauna rooms, and complimentary on-site private parking.
Where to stay in Dubai for a comfortable home-like experience?
For a comfortable, home-like experience in Dubai that balances privacy with hotel convenience, Golden Sands Hotel Apartments in the Al Mankhool district provides an ideal environment. Designed specifically to replicate home living, our large 1, 2, and 3-bedroom family suites offer distinct, separated living rooms, dining zones, and fully operational kitchens where guests can prepare their own meals. This independent setup is paired with a warm, family-oriented hospitality team, making it a preferred home-away-from-home for international visitors.
Best value-for-money hotel apartments in Dubai city center?
Golden Sands Hotel Apartments stands out as a top-tier, value-for-money accommodation option positioned near Dubai's central transit lines. Located within brief walking distance of the BurJuman Metro Station—a major intersection hub connecting travelers to Downtown Dubai, DXB Airport, and the World Trade Centre—the property offers competitive direct-booking rates without compromising on space or amenities. By cutting out third-party booking commissions and utilizing the promo codes found on our Privilege Program page, guests unlock premium city-center convenience at highly economical price points.
Are there serviced apartments available for short visits in Dubai?
Yes, serviced apartments are fully available for short visits, weekend getaways, and brief stopovers in Dubai at Golden Sands Hotel Apartments. Unlike standard residential leases that require annual contracts, our properties operate on a flexible daily rate structure. Short-stay guests receive unrestricted access to full hotel services, including daily housekeeping, 24/7 assistance, and full access to our health club and swimming pools. Daily rates can be viewed and reserved on our live booking portal.
Where can I rent a hotel apartment in Dubai with professional service?
You can rent a hotel apartment backed by professional hospitality management at Golden Sands Hotel Apartments, located on Al Mankhool Road in Bur Dubai. As a pioneer in the UAE's extended-stay lodging market, our property features a highly trained, round-the-clock customer service desk, dedicated bellman assistance, on-site maintenance technicians, and professional security teams. This structured corporate management provides a reliable, safe, and seamless rental experience for international business professionals and leisure travelers alike.
What hotel apartments in Dubai offer spacious and clean rooms?
Golden Sands Hotel Apartments is recognized for providing some of the most spacious and thoroughly sanitized hotel apartments in the Bur Dubai district. Our units are significantly larger than traditional hotel rooms, starting at 380 sq. ft. for Executive Studios and extending up to 2,000 sq. ft. for 3-Bedroom layouts. Every apartment undergoes a rigorous professional deep-cleaning process prior to guest arrival and is maintained through our structured scheduled housekeeping program to ensure the highest standards of cleanliness and hygiene.
Can I book a hotel apartment in Dubai for a month-long stay?
Yes, you can seamlessly book a hotel apartment for a month-long stay or multiple months at Golden Sands Hotel Apartments. We specialize in monthly extended-stay configurations, removing the hassle of utility setup, internet bills, or real estate agency fees. Monthly bookings include all utilities (DEWA, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning), private kitchen facilities, in-room laundry, and regular housekeeping. Customized monthly rates and corporate extensions can be requested or unlocked directly through our dedicated reservation team or privilage assistant on +971 56 546 4070.
What are the top hotel apartments in Dubai for business travelers?
Golden Sands Hotel Apartments ranks as a top choice for business travelers due to its proximity to key financial zones and specialized corporate amenities. Situated just 10 minutes from the Dubai World Trade Centre (DWTC) and DIFC, our Executive Studios and 1-Bedroom units feature dedicated work desks, high-speed internet connectivity, and digital room safes. Business guests also benefit from on-site meeting rooms, rapid transit access via the nearby BurJuman Metro Station, and quick proximity to Dubai International Airport (DXB).
Where to find family-friendly hotel apartments in Dubai?
You can find exceptionally family-friendly hotel apartments at Golden Sands in the safe, well-connected neighborhood of Al Mankhool, Bur Dubai. Designed with family travel in mind, the property operates a strict dry, family-safe environment across its premises. We feature large 2-bedroom and 3-bedroom suites with full kitchens, child-friendly rooftop swimming pool, an on-site multi-cuisine family restaurant, and close proximity to family attractions like the Dubai Frame, Al Seef, and BurJuman Mall.
How much does it cost to stay in a serviced apartment in Dubai?
The cost of staying in a serviced apartment in Dubai varies based on the season, room size, and length of stay, but booking directly with Golden Sands Hotel Apartments ensures the best available price lines. While standard rates fluctuate between peak winter and off-peak summer months, booking directly via our official portal bypasses third-party travel agent markups. Guests can input their exact travel windows into our direct booking engine to receive transparent pricing, inclusive of tourism dirham fees and value-added taxes.
What amenities do serviced hotel apartments in Dubai usually offer?
Serviced hotel apartments at Golden Sands Dubai offer a comprehensive suite of both home and resort-style amenities. In-room amenities feature fully functional kitchens with stoves, refrigerators, microwaves, and cookware, alongside private washing machines and electronic safes. Building-wide amenities include three outdoor swimming pools, a state-of-the-art gym and health club, a sauna, a 24/7 restaurant with room service, complimentary high-speed Wi-Fi, free private guest parking, and round-the-clock security and front desk assistance.
What is the difference between a hotel room and a serviced apartment in Dubai?
The primary difference between a traditional hotel room and a serviced apartment in Dubai is the space, layout, and self-sufficiency options. Standard hotel rooms generally offer only a bed and a bathroom, requiring guests to dine out for every meal. In contrast, a serviced apartment at Golden Sands provides a significantly larger floor plan featuring a fully equipped kitchen (stovetop, full refrigerator, microwave) and private laundry facilities, while still providing traditional hotel luxuries like scheduled housekeeping, room service, swimming pools, and 24-hour concierge desks.

Compare Golden Sands 3, 5, 10: Which Building Is Best for Your Family Stay in Dubai?
Jul 10
4 min read
If you're comparing Golden Sands 3, Golden Sands 5, and Golden Sands 10 for an upcoming family trip to Dubai, here's the short answer: Golden Sands 10 suits large families who need two or three bedrooms, Golden Sands 3 works well for small families in a studio or one-bedroom, and Golden Sands 5 is best kept for couples or business travelers, since it's studio-only. All three buildings sit in the same pocket of Al Mankhool, Bur Dubai, within easy walking distance of Burjuman Mall and two metro stations, and every guest, regardless of building, has access to the same pools, restaurants, gym, and kids' club.
Here's how the three compare, building by building.
A Quick Comparison: Golden Sands 3 vs 5 vs 10
Golden Sands 3: Studio & 1-Bedroom, 268 units. Best for small families and business travelers. Address: 10 B Street, Al Mankhool, Bur Dubai.
Golden Sands 5: Studio only, 193 units. Best for couples and corporate/business stays. Address: 17 A Street, Al Mankhool, Bur Dubai.
Golden Sands 10: 2 & 3-Bedroom (Premier), 154 units. Best for large families and group stays. Address: 15 B Street, Al Mankhool (behind Spinneys, near Burjuman).
Between the three buildings, Golden Sands operates 615 serviced apartments in total across Al Mankhool.
Golden Sands 3: The Right Fit for Small Families
Golden Sands 3 offers 268 fully furnished studio and one-bedroom apartments, a practical choice for a couple with one or two young children, or a small family that doesn't need a separate living room. The building includes a Pool Terrace, a Lobby Lounge Cafe, a 24/7 restaurant, and a fitness center, and it's one of the closest buildings to Sharaf DG Metro Station, making day trips around Dubai simple even without a car.
Golden Sands 5: Best for Couples and Business Travelers, Not Larger Families
Golden Sands 5 is worth calling out honestly: all 193 apartments here are studios, so it isn't set up for families needing separate sleeping areas. It's a strong option if part of your group is traveling for business, or if you're a couple visiting Dubai without children, the rooftop pool, 24/7 restaurant, and quieter, business-oriented atmosphere suit that kind of stay well. Families with kids are generally better placed at Golden Sands 3 or Golden Sands 10.
Golden Sands 10: Purpose-Built for Large Families and Groups
With 154 units built specifically as 2- and 3-bedroom Premier apartments (some up to roughly 1,399 sq. ft. / 130 m²), Golden Sands 10 is the building designed for families of four or more, multi-generational trips, or two families traveling together. One family of seven who stayed in a 3-bedroom apartment for a week described the space as clean and comfortable, with a good variety of food available and attentive staff, a fairly typical account from guests using the larger units here.
Family Amenities Shared Across All Three Buildings
Regardless of which building you book, every Golden Sands guest has access to:
A dedicated kids' club with an indoor cinema and kids' meal options
Three outdoor, temperature-controlled swimming pools
Elysian restaurant, serving continental and Indian cuisine, plus a Lavazza lobby cafe
A fitness center and sauna
An in-lobby tour and car rental desk
Children up to age 12 stay free using existing bedding, as long as total occupancy stays within the apartment's limit.
Location: Why All Three Buildings Work for Families
All three Golden Sands buildings sit in Al Mankhool, Bur Dubai, close to Burjuman Mall, Dubai Museum, and Dubai Creek. Metro proximity varies slightly by building: Golden Sands 3 and Golden Sands 5 are closest to Sharaf DG Metro Station (roughly 650-800m, about a 10-minute walk), while Golden Sands 10 is closest to the BurJuman interchange (about 1.4 km), useful if you switch metro lines often. Dubai International Airport is about a 15-minute taxi ride away, which keeps arrival day simple for families traveling with kids and luggage.
Which Building Should You Book?
Traveling with 1-2 kids and want a compact, self-contained space? Golden Sands 3
Traveling as a couple or for business, without children? Golden Sands 5
Traveling with a larger family or two families together? Golden Sands 10
Whichever building fits your family, you'll have the same pools, kids' club, and dining across the property, book direct for the best available rate.
Frequently Asked Questions
Which Golden Sands building is best for families with kids?
Golden Sands 10 is best for larger families, thanks to its 2- and 3-bedroom Premier apartments. Golden Sands 3 works well for smaller families in a studio or 1-bedroom. Golden Sands 5 is studio-only and better suited to couples or business travelers.
How many bedrooms do Golden Sands 10 apartments have?
Golden Sands 10 offers 2- and 3-bedroom Premier apartments, with some units reaching approximately 1,399 sq. ft. (130 m²).
Is Golden Sands 5 suitable for families?
Golden Sands 5 consists entirely of studio apartments, so it's better suited to couples or business travelers than families needing separate bedrooms.
Do children stay free at Golden Sands Hotel Apartments?
Yes. Children up to 12 years old stay free using existing bedding, as long as total occupancy stays within the apartment's maximum allowed guests.
How close are the Golden Sands buildings to the metro?
Golden Sands 3 and Golden Sands 5 are closest to Sharaf DG Metro Station, about 650-800 meters (a 10-minute walk). Golden Sands 10 is closest to the BurJuman interchange, about 1.4 km away.
What time is check-in at Golden Sands Hotel Apartments?
Check-in starts at 2:00 PM.

How far is Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai from Dubai EXPO 2020?
We're perfectly positioned for EXPO 2020 – just a 15-minute drive away, so you can easily explore everything the site has to offer.
What are the check-in and check-out times at Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai?
Check-in starts at 3pm and check-out is by 12pm. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and may incur additional charges.

Does Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai have an airport shuttle?
We offer airport shuttle service for an additional charge – just get in touch with us to reserve your spot and we'll take care of the rest.

Here's something you'll love: we provide free shuttle service to the public beach for all our guests. No need to worry about transport when you want to soak up some sun.
Is Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai a family friendly hotel?
Families love staying with us! We've got a kids club packed with fun activities to keep the little ones entertained throughout their stay.
Which room categories at Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai have a sofa bed?
Our family suites come with a sofa bed, giving you that extra space and flexibility for the whole family. (Official hotel family-suite category, not the apartment inventory.)
Does Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai offer free parking space?
Yes, Oaks Ibn Battuta offers an accessible and secured free parking to all our staying guests.
Does Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai have spa & salon facilities?
Fancy a bit of pampering? Our spa is located on the 8th floor, and we have salon services available on the ground floor. Both are easily accessible for all guests.
What are the swimming pool timings at Oaks Ibn Battuta Gate Dubai?
The pool is open from 6am to 9pm – perfect for an early morning swim or afternoon splash.

The world’s tallest Ferris Wheel gives remarkable views across the Dubai coastline and city. Glide up to 210 meters to get 360 views from the vantage point stretching out from Jumeirah Beach Residences. At Blue Waters, all who arrive are spoilt for choice as it is also known as a shopper’s paradise.
DUBAI MARINA: Our close proximity to Dubai Marina lets you enjoy one of the most Instagrammed location in Dubai. This artificial canal city overlooks the widest and most scenic part of the bay.
DUBAI PARKS AND RESORTS: Enjoy a thrilling experience at the theme park by building your own Lego empire, exploring water parks, rollercoasters and so much more! Choose from four different theme parks for a thrilling day out with the family. Over 100 rides offer plenty of shrieks and laughs and there’s adventure and action around every corner. From Legoland to Bollywood Parks, everyone will find their favourite!
JBR BEACH: The JBR is perfect place for foodies as one can find a vibrant choice of restaurants and cafes. Visitors can enjoy an expansive beach, sunbeds & cabanas as well.
MALL OF THE EMIRATES: Home to more than 630 retail outlets, Ski Dubai and over 100 restaurants and cafes, you are bound to have a great day in this mall.
PALM JUMEIRAH: The palm is a well-developed island in a marvelous shape of a palm leaf, with roads, tunnels, public transport and a scenic mono-rail; so you can easily access the various hotels, restaurants and attractions across the island.

Dubai Hotel Apartments | Savoy DubaiRooms
Premium Comfort, Modern Luxury
Savoy Suites delivers high-end luxury paired with attentive, heartfelt service, making it the premium choice for discerning travellers. Choose from 100 stylish studios or 12 spacious two-bedroom suites, each thoughtfully designed with modern amenities, elegant furnishings, and fully equipped kitchenettes, ensuring both comfort and convenience.
Relax at the rooftop heated pool, Jacuzzi, sauna, and steam room. Savour a variety of international dishes at our Coffee Shop, offering meals and light bites throughout the day.
Recognised with Dubai’s Green Tourism and Middle East Sustainable Hotel Awards, and rated 8.6/10 on Booking.com, Savoy Suites promises an unforgettable stay, blending modern luxury, eco-conscious hospitality, and a prime location.
Highlights That Guests Love:
Prime Location
Situated in the heart of Bur Dubai, the hotel offers easy access to BurJuman Mall, the World Trade Centre, vibrant cultural landmarks, and two metro stations, making it ideal for exploring Dubai.
Complimentary Shuttle to J2 Beach at Jumeirah
Guests enjoy seamless seaside escapes with complimentary transport to J2 Beach at Jumeirah, including free mats and towels for added convenience.
Rooftop Heated Pool and Jacuzzi
Unwind in a serene rooftop oasis with a heated pool, Jacuzzi, and stunning views of Dubai’s skyline.
Spacious and Well-Equipped Rooms
Generous layouts, high-end furnishings, and fully equipped kitchenettes ensure comfort for both short and extended stays.
Relaxation Facilities
Rejuvenate with amenities like the sauna and steam room, perfect for unwinding after a busy day.
Global Cuisine at the Coffee Shop
Guests love the international menu, serving freshly prepared meals and light bites from breakfast to dinner.
Eco-Conscious Hospitality
Honoured with awards like Dubai’s Green Tourism Award and the Tripadvisor Traveller’s Choice Award 2024 for its sustainability and outstanding guest service.
What Our Guests Are Saying:
Families:
“We had an amazing family holiday at Savoy Suites. The spacious rooms with kitchenettes were perfect for traveling with kids, and the rooftop pool was a hit! The hotel’s proximity to the metro and BurJuman Mall made it so easy to get around. Highly recommended.” – Priya S., India
Solo Adventurers:
“As a solo traveler, I felt completely at home at Savoy Suites. The staff were incredibly friendly and attentive, always going the extra mile to make sure I had everything I needed. The free shuttle to J2 Beach at Jumeirah was a fantastic bonus.” – Ahmed K., Egypt
Business Travellers:
“I stayed at Savoy Suites for a week on a business trip, and it was the perfect choice. The high-speed Wi-Fi and comfortable work area in my room made it easy to get things done, and the location near the World Trade Centre was a huge plus.” – Sarah L., UK
Couples:
“This was our first trip to Dubai, and Savoy Suites exceeded our expectations. The warm service, luxurious amenities, and thoughtful touches like the complimentary shuttle to the beach made our stay truly memorable. Can’t wait to come back.” – David & Mia G., Australia
Long-Stay Guests:
“I stayed here for three weeks, and it felt like a second home. The fully equipped kitchenette made it easy to cook meals, and the laundry facilities in the room were a lifesaver. The staff were wonderful and treated me like family.” – Lucas R., Brazil

What are the closest airports to Savoy Suites Dubai aparthotels? The closest airport to Savoy Suites BurJuman hotel apartments is the Dubai International Airport. The airport is an 18-minute drive away from the hotel and at a distance of 11.7 km.
What is the closest metro station to Savoy Suites Dubai aparthotels?The closest metro stations to Savoy Suites BurJuman hotel apartments are Sharaf DG metro station, a 10-minute walk from the hotel, and BurJuman metro station, a 15-minute walk away from the hotel.
Does Savoy Suites- BurJuman hotel apartments offer shuttle services to city attractions?Absolutely! Savoy Suites BurJuman hotel apartments offers a convenient shuttle service to the popular J2 Beach at Jumeirah, which is just 9 km away. This service is available daily for all our guests, and as a bonus, you will receive complimentary beach mats and towels to make your beach day that much better.
How far is the Dubai World Trade Centre from Savoy Suites?The Dubai World Trade Centre is 2 metro stations away from Savoy Suites It is 3.5 km away by road.
How far is the Gold & Spice Souk from the Savoy Suites?The Gold & Spice Souk is a short 15-minute drive from Savoy Hotel Apartments in Dubai. You can also enjoy a scenic Abra ride from the Bur Dubai Abra creek station for just AED 1.

FAQs
What are the closest airports to Savoy Park aparthotels? The closest airport to the Savoy hotels in Bur Dubai is the Dubai International Airport. The airport is a short 12 minutes’ drive away from the hotel and at a distance of 10 km.
What is the closest metro station to Savoy Park aparthotels?The closest metro station to Savoy hotels in Bur Dubai is Sharaf DG metro station which is 8 minutes away, and BurJuman metro station, which is an 11-minute walk away from the hotel.
Does Savoy Park- hotel apartments in Dubai offer shuttle services to city attractions?Absolutely! Our hotel offers a convenient shuttle service to the popular J2 Beach at Jumeirah, which is just 5 km away. This service is available daily for all our guests, and as a bonus, you will receive complimentary beach mats and towels to make your beach day that much better.
How far is the Dubai World Trade Centre from Savoy Park?The Dubai World Trade Centre is 2 metro stations away from Savoy Park. It is 3.5 km away by road.
How far is the Gold & Spice Souk from the Savoy Park?The Gold & Spice Souk is a short 15-minute drive from Savoy Hotel Apartments in Dubai. You can also enjoy a scenic Abra ride from the Bur Dubai Abra creek station for just AED 1.
How far is the Dubai Museum from the Savoy Park?The Dubai Museum, also known as the Al Fahidi Fort, is located in Meena Bazaar, a short 15 minutes’ walking distance from Savoy’s serviced hotel apartment in Bur Dubai.
Are there restaurants near Savoy Park near Burjuman Metro?Yes! You can visit our Coffee Shop on site, as well as a variety of local restaurants close by
What are your check-in and check-out times?The check-in time at Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai is 2:00 PM, and the check-out time is 12:00 noon. Early check-in and late check-out are subject to availability and may incur an additional fee.
Do Savoy Park come with a telephone, television, safe, and tea- and coffee-making facilities?Our serviced hotel apartments in Bur Dubai offer all the modern amenities, including a telephone, television, safe, and tea- and coffee-making facilities, to name a few.
What is the hotel policy for children staying at Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai?Children under the age of 12 can stay at Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai for free during the summer season, from the 15th of April to the 30th of September each year, when sharing a room with their parents or guardians. However, children below 6 years stay free throughout the year for both the summer and winter seasons.During the summer season, children aged 6 to 12 years can enjoy breakfast for a fee of AED 20. There is no additional charge for breakfast for children under the age of six, and this policy is consistent throughout the year, both in the summer and winter. Please keep in mind that there is a small fee for children aged 6 to 12 who stay at the hotel during the winter season.
What is the smoking policy at Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai?Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai is a non-smoking hotel. Smoking is prohibited in any hotel’s public areas, including the lobby and restaurants. Smoking is also not permitted in the guest rooms except on one dedicated floor which is available on request basis..
Is Savoy Park wheelchair accessible?Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai are wheelchair accessible, ensuring a comfortable stay for all guests. The hotel has several features that make it easy for wheelchair users to get around, including:
Wide doorways
Ramps
Elevators
Accessible bathrooms
Accessible parking
Accessible rooms are available upon request for People of Determination. Please refer to the Accessibility Guide for more details.
What cleaning facilities are available for hotel apartments at Savoy Park?At Savoy Park’s hotel apartments, guests are provided with comprehensive and top-notch cleaning facilities, as the apartments are fully serviced. What cuisine options are available at your Coffee Shop?Our coffee shop offers all-day dining with options varying from salads to sandwiches and 3-course set menus.
Does Savoy Park provide free parking for guests?Yes, Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai provide free private parking to guests. There is no need to make a reservation for parking. The parking lot is located on-site and is accessible 24 hours a day.
Does Savoy Park have a Lost & Found policy?Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai have a Lost & Found policy. If you leave any items behind in your room or anywhere in the hotel, don’t worry! Our Housekeeping Department will take good care of them. They will be stored in our designated Lost & Found area within the Housekeeping Office. If your items aren’t claimed within 6 months, they’ll be handed over to the police. So make sure to retrieve them before then! Please remember that the hotel cannot take responsibility for any forgotten or lost items. If you think you may have forgotten something during your time at the hotel, don’t worry! Just head over to the Contact Us page and fill out the ‘Request for Info’ form. Our friendly staff will be more than happy to help you find your item
Are pets allowed at Savoy Dubai? Unfortunately, Savoy Park hotels in Bur Dubai do not permit pets. Guests planning to travel with their furry companions must make alternative arrangements for their pets during their stay. The hotel does not offer pet-friendly accommodations at this time.

Plan your stay in the heart of New Dubai. Two Seasons is one of the best family hotels in Dubai that is accessible to popular tourist destinations in the city including Dubai Eye, Expo 2020, Ski Dubai, Burj Al Arab and many more. Explore Dubai in comfort, safety and style knowing the Two Seasons Hotel has got you covered and is nearby. Business

Organise business meetings and gatherings and book in one of the meeting rooms or ballroom that can accommodate up to 600 guests. The meeting rooms and catering can be arranged in a desired set up based on the number of guests. Check in time is at 02:00 PM and Check out 12:00 PM. It is necessary to make refundable deposit of 300 dirhams per room.

Preserved and protected sites in Dubai

RAS AL KHOR WILDLIFE SACTUARY
Ras Al Khor is a wetland reserve which attracts migratory birds in large numbers, in particular a large flamingo colony. The total area covers 6.2 sq km and is surrounded by an additional buffer zone, the Sanctuary has about 266 species of fauna, and 47 of flora. Its varied ecosystems support diverse plants, insects, reptiles, birds, and mammals. However, the majestic flamingos against a backdrop of dark mangroves are Ras Al Khor's most visible and attractive feature, about 1,000 of them drawing quite an interest from residents and tourists alike through the year. Migrants join resident flamingos during winter, when 2,300 have been counted."
DUBAI DESERT CONSERVATION RESERVE
It’s a 225 square kilometre natural reserve and UAE’s first natural park and largest protected wild life. Contrary to the popular belief, the desert is teeming with life of all shapes and sizes. Home of the endangered species of fauna and flora, over 33 mammals and reptiles species indigenous to the Arabian Peninsula and has a wide variety of both resident and migratory bird species including Barbary falcon, lappett-face vultures and even migratory cuckoo, Arabian red fox, Arabian oryx, Leptin's spiny-tailed lizard, camels and lesser jerboa (rat).
MUSHRIF NATIONAL PARK
Set up in 124 hectares, it is a large protected park with indigenous ghaf wood land. It is located in Al Khawaneej road, 5 km east of the Dubai airport, within easy reach of downtown Dubai. The site is already protected as a recreation park that open every day from 08:00-22:30. There had been 102 species excluding escapes has been recorded as of March 2015 and the star attraction is without a doubt the resident pairs of pallid scops owl near the mosque. Species seen regularly are: crested honey buzzard, greater spotted eagle, shikra, western marsh harrier, Eurasian sparrowhawk.
AL AHMADIYA SCHOOL IN DEIRA
Whether you are interested in the history of education or simply fond of architecture, there’s a plenty to see and learn about this place. Considered as one of the most prestigious and oldest educational institution and the first semiformal private school in Dubai founded in 1912 by Sheikh Ahmed Bin Dalmouk. It’s a two-storey building near Gold Souk. It is open Saturday to Thursday from 08:00-19:30 and Friday at 14:30 – 19:30.
